title: David Konckier, owner of Bogart Group, completes acquisition of Marionnaud
summary: David Konckier, the main shareholder of the Bogart Group, has finalized the acquisition of the Marionnaud Group through his company BEHN. The transaction, undertaken in a personal capacity, was initially announced in a press release on July 6. The selective perfumery retailer thus comes under the control of the businessman, following more than 20 years under the ownership of Hong Kong-based conglomerate CK Hutchison, which also owns the AS Watson retail group.
